recipe.title: Lockdown loaf (beer bread)
recipe.notes: Amy and I first made this Chelsea Winter recipe on 28 March 2020, during the first nationwide COVID-19 lockdown.

i.n: beer, or make up any shortfall with water

method.s: Mix dry ingredients. Make a well and pour in beer. Stir to combine.
Pour into a small-medium lined loaf tin.
Drizzle lightly with olive oil and any toppings - cheese and herbs/spices work well.
